title: Big, Bold, Beautiful - E-flite Pilatus PC-21 1.3m Review
description:
The E-flite Pilatus PC-21 is not only big, it's very bold with a striking red scheme, and beautiful in its detailing. This 1.3m wingspan warbird-like aircraft can do an amazing amount of aerobatics very smoothly - or be thrown around without a care. Like what you see? 

Pick up your own Pilatus PC-21 via https://bit.ly/E-flitePC-21_BNF to support what we do at no additional charge. Get it PNP for less and put your own receiver in it: https://bit.ly/E-flitePC-21_PnP
